//: DocLink target switch. Change "target" to "mock" or "real", save this file, then reload DocLink in chrome://extensions. No other file needs to change and no command needs to run.
//recon: Save to: Recon (S3). reconBaseUrl = the Recon Engine API (its origin must also be in manifest.json host_permissions); reconCustomerId = the Recon customer the files belong to; reconAppUrl (optional) = the page 'Open Recon Engine' opens for sign-in, defaults to reconBaseUrl.
//okta: Recon Engine sign-in with Okta (the second login, after IREPS). DocLink opens this Okta app through chrome.identity; register the redirect https://<extension id>.chromiumapp.org/okta in the Okta app (DocLink's sign-in page shows the exact value). The client SECRET never goes here: the Recon backend exchanges the code. enabled=false hides the Okta button.
//downloadLog: Download log (services/download-log.js): every file DocLink saves is recorded in the Recon Engine for the signed-in user (POST {reconBaseUrl}/api/doclink/downloads), and before a run DocLink asks which documents that user already downloaded to the same destination (and, under ECM / S3, which are already in their ECM folder) and offers to skip them. It needs the Recon sign-in for every run. false turns all of it off (old behaviour); config.local.json may override it.
//ecm: Save to: ECM / S3 for IC, PO, MA and tender documents. ecmBackendAws=true sends them through the Recon Engine's ECM gateway (POST {reconBaseUrl}/api/ecm/documents, Recon sign-in needed); false calls the ECM (Nuxeo) directly from DocLink with the client credentials below (local testing). env = TEST or PROD picks the ECM folders (services/ecm-catalog.js); domain's origin must also be in manifest.json host_permissions. Never put a real client id / secret here: put them in config.local.json (same shape, gitignored, never packaged), which overrides this file.
